Official Online Store of the LSU Tigers, LSU Football Gear

Gear up for another epic season with all the LSU football gear you need to look stylish in the stands, and you can support your favorite athletes with LSU NIL jerseys! Score tons of LSU Gear, including LSU sideline gear and LSU Nike Pegasus shoes for the upcoming season! Shop all the elite Tigers baseball gear in the shop, including LSU jerseys, hoodies, hats, and so much more. Support your team while you honor the military with any of the LSU OHT Gear featured in the shop. Along with all our LSU baseball gear, fans also can snag the official LSU softball gear that fans need to support their in-season squads. Shop LSU Merchandise at the Official Store of Louisiana State University where you can find the ultimate selection of LSU Clothes for Men, Women and Kids Tiger Fans. Our Fan Shop features LSU Apparel in the most popular brands such as Nike and Adidas. Shop for everyone on your list and find in-demand styles of LSU Tigers baseball & softball Clothing and Fan Gear. Support Louisiana State University and purchase your brand new Tigers Attire to cheer them on at the next event.

LSU College World Series Champs Gear

LSU has done it again—bring home the win with LSU College World Series Champions gear from the official LSU Shop. From bold championship t-shirts and hats to must-own LSU baseball gear, every piece celebrates this unforgettable season. Discover jerseys, sweatshirts, accessories, and collectibles that capture the spirit of Tigers Baseball. This is your one-stop destination for LSU College World Series Champions gear that’s made for true fans.

LSU Football Gear

Celebrate the legacy of Tigers football with LSU football gear from LSU Shop. Show your pride in the team’s storied history, from their multiple national championships to unforgettable seasons under the lights of Tiger Stadium. Our selection includes officially licensed jerseys, hats, and accessories that honor the rich tradition of LSU football. Embrace the spirit of Louisiana State University and join the ranks of fans who cheer on the Tigers with pride and passion.

Tigers Basketball Jerseys & Apparel

Show your support for Tigers basketball with LSU basketball gear from LSU Shop. Dive into our collection of officially licensed apparel and merchandise that celebrates the Tigers’ impressive history and their fierce play on the court. From vintage-inspired jerseys to must-have accessories, each item reflects the pride and passion of LSU fans. Gear up with the latest and greatest, and stand with the Tigers as they aim for victory this season.

LSU Baseball and Softball Merch

Step up your game with LSU Tigers baseball and softball gear from LSU Shop. Celebrate the rich tradition of LSU's powerhouse programs, recognized for their dynamic play and national titles. Our officially licensed merchandise showcases iconic designs, paying homage to the Tigers' storied history, including multiple College World Series appearances and SEC championships. Discover premium apparel and fan essentials that honor LSU’s legacy. Equip yourself with the finest LSU gear and stand proud with every swing and pitch.
